column3: Pulled hard early - settled midpack - jostled and urged along 2f out - closed to challenge inside final 110yds - hit front and drew clear for the win
Pulled hard early - up with the pace - pushed along over 2f out - moved to the front shortly after - challenged entering the final 110yds - worn down close home and finished second by 1½ lengths
Sluggish start - settled midpack - pressed for effort 2f out - drifted left then shifted right approaching final furlong - stayed on to snatch third close home
Settled in the front rank - pressed for effort 3f out - well placed with 2f to run - edged back into fourth approaching the last furlong and unable to find more late
Settled in the pack early - slipped towards the back 4f out - pushed along and made progress under 2f out - couldn't quicken again close home to finish fifth
Close to pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong
Fought for control early - settled towards the back - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on late finishing 7th beaten 4 lengths
Slow to break - fought for control early - up front and harried for the lead - pressed for effort with 2f left - overtaken soon after - dropped away inside the last furlong
Sluggish start - fought for control early - settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground final furlong to finish ninth
Well placed in second early - hit front with 4f remaining - pushed along inside final furlong under pressure from rivals - drifted left but dug in to prevail

Slow to break and settled last - made steady progress into contention over 2f out - driven up to dispute third and threaded a path to loom up with a shout entering the final furlong - just failed to get up in the last 110yds
Settled midfield early - improved into third with 5f left - driven from over a furlong out to close on the front-runner - kept responding to the line - narrowly denied in third
Held up in the pack early - improved into fourth with 5f left - pressed approaching final 2f and stayed on at one speed to finish 4th
Towards the back - roused over 3f out - out of contention from 2f out
Went straight to the front - lost command 4f from home - driven to keep up before dropping away - well held at the finish
Sat handy behind front group early - urged on with encouragement 6f out then quickly lost touch - allowed to drop out of contention 4f out and finished well held

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - up with the pace - dropped away from that group inside the last 3f - pushed along with 2f left - boxed in briefly with a furlong to run - finished strongly to score in the closing strides

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early in the pack - still handy with the front group 4f out - pushed along with 2f left - edged in front inside the final 110yds - fought on but caught close to the line finishing second by a short head

Raced fresh early and set the pace - pressed and driven along 3f out - stayed on going into the final furlong - edged sideways and lost front spot near the last 110yds - couldn't quicken again close home - clung on for third at the finish
Pulled hard early - settled midpack - pressed along with two furlongs left - made progress inside final furlong - stayed on but narrowly denied third
Pulled hard early - settled in the pack - pushed along 2f out - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Handy early - shared front spot 3f out - pushed along 2f out - drifted left and lost place inside final furlong - held on for sixth without finding more

Dwelt badly at the break and dropped well off the pack - fighting for control while towards the back - within range by the 2f pole - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on through the last furlong to finish strongest of all but well held in 7th
Pulled hard early - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left and edged forward late but beaten in 8th
Pulled hard early - tracked front group - pressed for effort 2f out - found room and improved into final furlong but squeezed for space - unable to get back on terms late
Fought for control early - settled midpack - within range of pace 3f out - pushed along and dropped away last furlong
Never a factor - trailed throughout - finished well held in 11th
Held up towards the back - made smooth headway before 2f out then eased across and driven approaching the final furlong - kept on to get up close home
Settled in the pack - moved left and driven up into contention approaching final 2f - hit the front inside last furlong - caught close home and unable to find more
Settled towards the back - made ground from 2f out and kept on when pressed over 1f out - outpaced by the leading duo in the final 110yds to finish third
Settled midpack early - improved into contention 2f out - hit the front briefly with a furlong left before being reeled in - stayed on same gear to finish fourth
Sat close behind front group early - urged for effort with 2f remaining - lost ground final furlong - finished 5th beaten 7 lengths
Handy early - roused to move ahead past the 1f marker - lost front spot soon after and dropped away - finished 6th
Towards the rear of the central group - edged nearer 3f out - ridden 2f out - made no inroads and beaten off 1f out
Disputed the front - pressed for pace from 2f out - surrendered the advantage past the 1f marker - faded to finish 8th
Settled behind the front group early - urged forward with two furlongs left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished ninth
Settled in the pack - urged forward with over 2f left - faded from there to finish 10th
Held up at the back from the start - dropped away 3f out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack wide of rivals - roused with over 3f left - dropped away fast in the closing stages - finished well behind in 12th

Tracked the front group early - pressed for effort 2f out - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on under pressure though margin shrank close home - just prevailed at the line

Settled mid-pack early - improved into third with 5f left - pressed for effort 3f out - dropped back a place approaching final furlong - rallied over the closing 110yds to regain second - edged closer at the line but no more than that
Pulled hard early - hit the front - pressed for the lead 3f out under pressure - overtaken inside final furlong - briefly dropped back - fought on to finish third
Settled towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on well to finish fourth
Settled towards the rear of the field - made ground to challenge approaching the final furlong - found little and faded into 5th
Settled towards the back - pushed along and eased right approaching 2f out - crept closer inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten 4 lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 4f left - unable to make further progress and dropped away late
Sluggish start settling last - moved into the front group by the 1f mark - shared control 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out then overtaken inside the final furlong - faded quickly to finish 8th
Held up in the pack early - made progress from 2f out - into fourth with a furlong left - hit the front inside the final 110yds to score
Front early - pressed for stride 2f out - fought back gamely under pressure 1f out - passed 110yds out - not quicken to match winner - went down by 1¼ lengths in second
Up with the front group - niggled approaching the 2f marker - plugged on at one speed to finish third
Handy early - driven with 2f to run - kept on without threatening the front - finished 4th
Held up in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - kept responding to finish without getting on terms
Held handy position early - gained ground under pressure approaching final furlong - denied room and knocked sideways with a furlong left - unable to regain momentum finishing sixth
Settled in the pack - driven to make progress 2f out - couldn't sustain the effort inside the final furlong and finished 7th
Held up towards the back - driven approaching halfway - kept going without threatening leaders - finished eighth beaten 5½ lengths
Settled forwardly-placed but pulling hard early - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find any extra - well held at the line
Held up towards the back - dropped away two furlongs out - well held at the line
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away - finished well back in 11th
Settled in the pack - pushed along and lost touch inside final 2f - eventually well held in 12th
Held up towards the back - asked for effort with 2f left - found nothing - finished 13th
Well placed on the outside - urged on approaching final 2f - fell back rapidly - finished well beaten in 14th
Stumbled start - fought for a strong grip early - travelled with the front group - pressed for effort 2f out - moved through to hit the front inside the last furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Pulled hard early - close to the front pack - pressed for effort 2f out and moved right - stayed on inside final furlong - claimed second close home
Went straight to front - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - overtaken inside final furlong - stayed on at unchanged gait but edged out of second close home
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - progress inside final furlong - stayed on at one speed to finish 4th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - progress from the last furlong - stayed on without threatening to finish 5th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 2f to run - stayed on but drifted left approaching the final furlong - finished sixth beaten 3.5 lengths
Slow to break at back of field - eased across left and pressed 2f out - edged forward late but only stayed on at one speed to finish 7th beaten 4 lengths
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on inside the last but never a threat
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 9th
Pulled hard early - raced handily - pressed for effort with 2f left - soon lost ground and faded well held
Raced up with the pace early - pushed along 3f out - dropped away 2f out - faded soon after and beaten well home
Tardy start - dropped back through the pack and outpaced from 2f out - no threat in the closing stages
Held up in rear throughout - never a factor - finished 13th
Sat behind the front group early - shifted left and asked for effort with 2f to run - kept responding inside final furlong - edged in front close to home - held on well to the line

Set the pace early - came under pressure from a rival over 3f out - driven out with 2f to run - edged back in front approaching the final furlong - caught close to home - unable to find more before the line
Settled midpack early - driven up into contention 2f out to share third - kept on at an even effort to the line
Handy on the rail early - challenged hard 3f out - driven approaching 2f before dropping away final furlong to finish 4th

Slow to break and hesitant leaving stalls - settled towards the back and urged forward - made ground on inner approaching final two furlongs - pressed for effort in third a furlong out - weakened before the line to finish fifth
Settled around midfield - urged forward with two furlongs left - unable to find any extra gear - finished sixth
Sat close to the front pack early - urged forward with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 7th
Slow to break - settled towards the back - made no impact - finished well beaten in 8th
Held up towards the back - urged to improve 2f out - found little - well held in 9th
Held up handy on the outside - under pressure and losing touch before being hampered with 2f left - well held at the finish
Hemmed in at the break - travelled eagerly in the pack - eased left and pressed for effort 2f out - moved through to hit the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on well to win
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left - moved up into contention approaching the final furlong - took second close home but unable to trouble the winner
Held a central position early - pressed for effort with 2f left then squeezed for space inside the final furlong - stayed on to snatch third close home
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort with 2f left and slipped back from second - dropped away inside final furlong to finish fourth
Drifted right at the off - settled close up with the pace - pressed forward under urging 2f out then dropped away - weakened final furlong to finish 5th
Settled off the leading group early - pressed for effort with 3f remaining - stayed on at one gear inside final furlong - finished sixth
Sent to front early - pressed for effort with over 2f left - overtaken nearing final furlong - lost momentum in closing stages to finish 7th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left to run - stayed on at one level inside the final furlong - finished 8th
Held up at the rear from the off - never a factor - well held at the finish
Handy early behind pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish well held

Drifted right at the off - settled in the pack - driven into contention 2f out - boxed in briefly then moved left 1f out - battling for third with 110yds left - finished strongly to get up in the final strides
Held up in midfield - made progress 3f out - driven into third over 2f out - struck the top 1f out - kept on - caught in the dying strides to finish second by a half-length

Settled midpack early - slipped back before halfway - dropped towards the back - began to close ground past the 2f marker - driven to improve and shared third turning in - held same effort to the line
Sat close behind the front group - urged forward with 2f left - kept going late but lacked the speed to get involved in the finish - finished 4th
Settled towards the back - driven to make progress 2f out - hampered 1f out when staying on - always held finishing 5th

Drifted left at the break - sat in a forward position before being driven to the front approaching 2f out - asked for effort soon after - overtaken entering the last furlong and dropped away to finish sixth
Held a midfield position early - eased left and driven approaching 2f out - knocked without gaining ground and faded late finishing seventh
Settled midfield early - urged to close ground approaching 3f out - reached leading group inside final furlong - lost momentum late to finish eighth
Hampered leaving stalls - held up at back - asked for effort 2f out but unable to find headway
Held up towards the back - boxed in with a furlong to go - always struggling to get involved - finished well held in 10th
Set the pace early - driven up front before giving way approaching 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 11th
Tracked the pace early - urged forward with 3f to go - lost touch rapidly inside the final 2f - well held at the finish
Handy in the front rank - asked for effort with 2f left - moved through to the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on to assert and win
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - moved into contention entering the last furlong - took second inside the final 110yds and stayed on to go down by half a length
Hampered start - settled close to pace - pushed into contention 2f out and challenged for lead approaching final furlong - flattened out to finish third in final 110yds
Quick break to front - held advantage until pushed along 2f out - overtaken and slipped to fourth approaching final furlong - continued at a steady effort to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - unable to close the gap approaching the final furlong - stayed on for fifth without threatening the front
Held mid-pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished sixth
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left then weakened close home
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on late finishing 8th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - lost momentum inside final furlong - finished 9th
Pulled hard early - settled mid-pack - pushed along with 2f left before fading inside the final furlong
Held up towards rear throughout - never a factor - well held in 11th
Up with the two leaders - moved to the fore just past the 2f pole and drew decisively ahead over 1f out - driven out and stayed on strongly to win
Settled midfield early - moved into fourth with 3f left - pressed for effort inside final 2f - closed into runner-up spot late but well beaten by the winner
Handy in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f remaining then edged out by the winner a furlong out - surrendered second inside the final 110 yards to finish third
Held a midfield position early - driven to improve going right with over 2f left and up into fourth inside the final furlong - stayed on without further gain to finish fourth
Up with the front group early - dropped away at halfway - made no impact and nudged aside inside the final 2f - beaten 15 lengths in fifth
Drifted sideways at the off - hit the front early then driven to keep going past 2f out - surrendered advantage soon after and faded into 6th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to find any headway thereafter
Slow into stride - driven out with encouragement needed late - never a factor - finished well beaten
Sluggish start - settled at the back - made no impression - eventually finished well beaten in 9th
Settled midfield - urged to keep tempo before fading two out - dropped away steadily to finish tenth
Tracked front group early - moved into second place 4f out - closed on the pacesetter 3f out - pushed along 2f out - edged in front approaching the final furlong - stayed on to assert and win
Handy in the early stages - dropped a place 4f out - pushed along and moved left 2f out - improved into second entering the last furlong - stayed on for a runner-up finish
Set the pace early - came under pressure with 3f left and asked for effort - lost front spot into final furlong slipping to third - unable to go with rivals late finishing third
Held up mid-pack - pressed for effort with 3f left - stayed on at one gait inside final furlong - finished fourth beaten 10 lengths
Dwelt at the start - settled at the back - pressed along with 5f left - made progress into contention 2f out then stayed on at one tempo late to finish fifth
pulling hard early - settled in the pack - pushed along 3f out - lost ground from 2f out and finished sixth
Held up in rear throughout - never a factor - finished well held in 7th
Raced free early - settled off the pace in the pack - pushed along with 3f left before fading inside the final furlong

Settled towards back of the pack - needed encouragement in the early stages - asked for effort with over 2f left - responded and kept going - powered through inside the final furlong to hit the front close home
Held up in the pack - made up ground from 3f out - driven into the lead approaching the final furlong - stayed on - caught near the line to finish second
Held up at the back - made progress from 3f out - driven with 2f left - stayed on late to finish third without threatening
Hit the front early - driven and lost the advantage by a short margin 2f out - held on for a while before weakening close home to finish fourth
Sat close to leading two early - pushed along with over 2f left - dropped away soon after and unable to quicken - finished fifth beaten 6 lengths
Sat close to the pace early - nudged into a slender advantage 2f out before being overtaken approaching the final furlong - then dropped away meekly
Settled in the pack early - urged forward at halfway - unable to respond thereafter - well held in 7th
Held up in the pack - urged forward before halfway - found nothing in the closing stages - finished eighth beaten some way
Held up towards the back - urged forward before halfway - made no impression thereafter - finished ninth well beaten
Settled in the pack early - urged forward before fading with 3f left - beaten a long way home in 10th
Up with the early pace - lost ground under pressure from the midpoint - dropped far adrift to finish 11th
Handy early - hit front over 2f out and driven along - clear approaching final furlong - margin narrowed close home - held on for the win
Settled in the pack early - moved up to second inside the final furlong under pressure - stayed on well but unable to reel in the winner
Sat close to the front group - dropped back with 2f to run then pushed along - found renewed effort to third in the closing furlong - stayed on without extra finishing third
Settled towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left and improved into fourth approaching the final furlong - unable to find enough to challenge and finished fourth beaten 5 lengths
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left then found some headway inside the final furlong - kept on late but never able to land a challenge
Sent clear early - driven approaching 2f out and lost the advantage - dropped away final furlong - finished sixth
Fought for control early - up with the pace before being asked for effort with 2f left - faded in the final furlong to finish seventh
Settled at back - urged forward inside final 2f - no real say in finish - beaten well home in 8th
Settled in the pack early - urged for effort with over two furlongs left - quickly slipped towards the back and was allowed to coast - pulled up before the final furlong

Tracked the front group early - urged forward with three furlongs left - given encouragement 2f out - stayed on from a furlong out - locked in a battle through the last furlong - got up right at the post
Settled behind pace early - hit front approaching 3f out - pressed for effort with 2f to go - battled on gamely from inside final furlong - edged out in tight finish for second
Tracked front pack early - urged forward with 3f left before driven approaching final two furlongs - stayed on at one gear to the line finishing third

Held up towards the back - improved into contention 3f out - denied clear run and forced right around 2f out - driven approaching final furlong and stayed on at an even effort to finish fourth beaten 3.5 lengths

Sluggish start and settled towards the back - urged along with over 3f left - drifted left approaching 2f out - stayed on at one pace inside the final furlong - couldn't find more in the last 110yds - finished fifth beaten 8.5 lengths
Settled in the pack early - urged into contention past the 3f marker - drifted left under pressure with 2f remaining - faded through the last furlong to finish sixth
Went straight to front - pressed for effort and lost command approaching 3f out - dropped away steadily inside final furlong to finish seventh
Travelled keenly in the pack - hampered for room 2f out and pushed along - unable to improve position from 1f out - finished well held in 8th
Sent forward from the off - clear in front throughout and asked for effort inside final furlong - stayed on to score
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final furlong - powered home late - denied by narrow margin in second
Handy in the pack early - pushed into second inside final furlong - edged out near line for third
Held handy early - urged into effort with 2f left - weakened in closing stages to finish 4th
Fought for control at the back early - pushed along with 2f left - moved through tired horses late but not landing a serious threat
Held up in the pack - driven with over 2f left - couldn't find any headway - finished sixth
Settled mid-pack early - pressed for pace with 2f left - unable to sustain the challenge and beaten into 7th
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left but couldn't land a challenge - finished 8th
Up with the front early - driven to the front 2f out - showed inexperience under the whip inside the final furlong but found plenty to pull out and win going
Travelled keenly early - tracked the front group then eased right approaching 2f out - a touch unfurnished but kept going to the line finishing second beaten 5.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven into contention 3f out - stayed on inside the last
Held up towards the back - pushed along 3f out with nothing left to give and slipped to the tail approaching the last furlong - fought back to claim fourth close home
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out then lost front spot - faded inside final furlong - slipped to rear close home finishing fifth
Settled in the pack early - travelling comfortably two out - pushed along and finding room approaching the final fence where drifted left over it - stayed on strongly to hit the front close home
Settled in the pack - pressed on to edge in front near the finish - stayed on but overtaken close home - beaten a short head into 2nd
Race close to the pace - challenged the front-runner three out and looked a threat approaching the last - lost momentum in the closing 110yds to finish third
Settled at the back early - travelling nicely with two furlongs left but boxed in before the last - stayed on to claim fourth close home
Fought for control early - sat close up and shared front spot from 2nd - overtaken 5th - pressed into effort but slipped back near last - dropped away inside final 110yds to finish 5th
Settled towards the back - pushed along before two out - made late progress approaching the last - stayed on without threatening
Set the pace early - shared control before going clear at the 5th - kept up pressure until 3 out - lost the advantage after an awkward jump at the last under pushing - soon dropped away to finish 7th
Held up mid-pack - pushed along and dropped back approaching last - stayed on at one speed - finished 8th
Settled close to the front pack early - pushed along before two out then dropped away approaching last - unable to make headway on the run-in finishing ninth
Held up in the pack - pushed along and faded two out - unable to threaten leading pair before the last - finished well beaten in 10th
Settled towards the back - eased and pulled up after the 2nd
Settled in the pack - pushed along with no response approaching 2 out - pulled up before the last
Held up at the rear - lost touch with the field - pulled up before 2 out
Settled close to the front rank early - pushed along and fell back before 2 out - eased and pulled up before the last
Settled just off the pace - pushed into contention inside final furlong - hit front close home to score
Held up handy in the early stages - shaken up to hit the front a furlong from home - caught close home to finish second
Settled towards the back - boxed in with a furlong left before angling right and pushed along - closed fast in the final 100yds - went down by a length
Settled in the pack early - found room and ran on inside the final furlong - squeezed for space briefly then pushed on once free - finished fourth keeping on to the line
Settled at the back early - pushed along a furlong out and found progress inside final furlong - kept going to finish fifth
Sat handy behind the front group - pushed along inside final furlong and threw down a bid over the last 110yds - faded quickly to finish sixth
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot inside final furlong - gave way in closing 110yds - allowed to finish steadily in 7th
Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort with a furlong left - unable to quicken and finished well beaten
Tracked front group early - urged forward with three furlongs left - hit the front approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line - held on for the win
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - finished strongly through the last furlong - just held for the runner-up spot
Held up towards the back - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - stayed on at one effort inside final furlong - finished 3rd beaten 1.5 lengths

Slow to break - held towards the back - asked for effort with much ground to make up and made progress over 2f out - pressed for response inside final furlong without threatening leaders - closed late to finish fourth
Set the early tempo in front - pushed along and lost the advantage over 2f out - stayed on at one gear inside the closing stages before finding a late surge to grab fifth close home
Sat close up early - pushed along to move in front over 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left - held on without finding more late and slipped back two spots close home
Seized the initiative from the off - challenged for advantage at the 9th - a length to the good 3 out - contested again 2 out - forged ahead before the last and kept on out
Settled off the leaders early - moved into second three out and challenged approaching two out - lost momentum before the last under pressure - finished second having plugged on steadily
Held a forward position early - edged upsides the leader by the 9th before yielding that spot 3 out - pushed along soon after - faded from 2 out to finish third
Jumped raggedly early - held up at the rear throughout - never able to challenge - finished a distant fourth
Settled just off the pace - roused into contention two out - swept through wide with a furlong left - hit the front late to score comfortably

Settled in the pack early - moved up two out and driven to the front approaching the final furlong - overtaken close home and stayed on gamely but unable to reclaim advantage - narrowly denied in second
Settled in the pack - pushed along inside final furlong and found extra late to move into third close home - held no chance with the leading two
Set the pace early - pushed along two out and lost command a furlong later - weakened in the closing stages to finish fourth
Handy in the pack early - driven up to press the leaders 2f out - lost momentum in the closing furlong to finish 5th
Settled at rear early - pushed along inside final furlong - made no real impression late - finished sixth
Settled close to the pace - squeezed for space with two furlongs left then pushed along - faded soon after and beaten well home
Sat behind pace early - roused to hit front approaching 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on comfortably for the win
Tracked the front group early - short of space approaching final two furlongs - moved left with a furlong to run - pressed for effort inside the closing stages but unable to reel in the winner
Held up at back - made steady progress into contention over 2f out - pushed along a furlong later - kept on well inside final furlong to finish third closest at the line
Travelled keenly early - settled in the pack - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - stayed on at one gait to finish fourth beaten 2.5 lengths
Held up towards the back - made progress and moved right over 3f out - pushed along over 2f out - drifted left inside final furlong - stayed on at same pace to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with over 2f left - unable to find extra gear - finished sixth
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost front spot approaching 2f out then slipped to rear inside final furlong - unable to find more in closing stages finishing seventh
Handy early - moved through to hit front and pushed along approaching last - edged left soon after - narrowed margin near line but stayed in front

Pulled hard - restrained in the pack - jumped poorly at the 5th - progress approaching 3 out - another untidy leap 2 out - under pressure soon after - worked into contention before the last - angled right and stayed on to go second on the line

Settled close to the front pack - moved into second place 2 out then asked for effort - up with the pace before the last where jump was untidy - stayed on without getting to the front - finished third beaten 2 1/4 lengths
Held clear advantage early - pushed along and lost top spot approaching final fence where slipped to fourth - unable to close ground on the run to the line
Settled at the back - minor interference at the 5th - pushed along after 2 out before plugging on at one tempo to finish 5th
Fought for control early - held up towards the rear throughout - never able to make an impression - well held at the finish
Handy with front group early - pressed for effort well before 3 out - dropped away after 2 out - well held at finish
Settled in second early - pushed to the front inside the final furlong - pulled away to score easily
Sat fourth early - urged forward approaching 2f out - rallied to claim second inside the final 110yds - always held by the winner
Held third early - pressed for a run 3f out - stayed on but never a factor - finished third
Sent clear early - driven approaching final two furlongs - overtaken with a furlong left and dropped away close home
Held up at the rear - pushed along with three furlongs left - dropped away quickly - finished a distant fifth
Set the pace from the off - clear throughout with no pressure - held on with plenty in hand to score
Held up at the back - pushed along and made ground into contention over 2f out - kept going inside the closing furlong to take second
Hampered and hesitant start - settled last - pushed along and made gains over 2f out - little threat until finding late pace in final 110yds - closed best of all to finish third
Drifted left at the off - sat behind the front-runner then pushed along over 2f out - stayed on at one gait late to finish fourth
Held mid-pack early - pressed for effort and lost touch over 2f out - slipped to the back and allowed to finish quietly
Settled in the pack early - moved through to press the front two before the final obstacle - driven along and close up when clear at the last then eased away to win
Settled in the pack early - a touch untidy 5th several out - pushed along at the back and hampered for fluency 2 out - stayed on into second before the last and held that effort to the line
Held up in rear early - crept into third on the run-in - well held at the finish

Went straight to front - stumbled at the 8th then yielded the advantage - dropped out of second spot before two out after an untidy leap - pressed for effort and unable to go with rivals - handed third for a moment approaching the final fence before weakening to finish fourth
Handy early - went to front from 8th and opened daylight by two out - driven on with lead shrinking approaching last where lost footing and parted company
Settled second early - pushed to the front two out - stretched clear approaching final furlong - edged back in close home - held on for the win
Veered right at the off - hit the front early - driven and lost the advantage over 2f out - fought back late to close but denied close home
